entries.title: Settlement Survival

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Settlement Survival is a PC city-builder with Steam Workshop support and a later paid mobile port on iOS/Android. The Steam release is the highest-fidelity route and the best archive target because it has the native desktop interface, Workshop ecosystem, and clean capture path; the Deluxe Edition adds the soundtrack rather than a gameplay-complete edition split.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for archive capture. Use the mobile port only for portable comparison, not as the definitive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam Workshop, achievements, desktop controls, and the cleanest capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most practical archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Mac Steam route when available through the same Steam app.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful native desktop alternative, but Windows PC remains the main capture target.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile adaptation published by X.D. Network for touch devices.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but lower capture/settings ceiling and likely interface differences from the desktop build.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced gameplay content split was found between PC and mobile; PC is both the fidelity-first and archive-practical route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition bundles the soundtrack with the base game; it is not a remaster or gameplay-complete edition.
